title: AASHTO Guide for the Development of Bicycle Facilities, 5th Edition

chapters.title: Introduction
chapters.summary: Overview of purpose, scope, structure, and range of design values.

chapters.title: Bicyclist Operation and Safety
chapters.summary: Bicyclist design user profiles, bicycle types and performance characteristics, operational preferences, and crash/safety challenges.

chapters.title: Bicycle Planning
chapters.summary: Low-stress bicycle network principles (safety, comfort, connectivity, legibility), planning processes, and transit integration.

chapters.title: Guidance for Choosing a Bikeway Type
chapters.summary: Bikeway selection framework based on motor vehicle speed, volume, and land-use context (aligned with FHWA Bikeway Selection Guide).

chapters.title: Elements of Design
chapters.summary: Design controls common across all bikeways: design speed, sight distance, operating space, geometric crossing treatments, and common traffic control devices.

chapters.title: Design of Shared Use Paths
chapters.summary: Independently aligned shared use paths (trails/paths/greenways): widths, shoulders, vertical/horizontal curves, grades, barriers, lighting, and roadway crossings.

chapters.title: Design of Separated Bike Lanes and Side Paths
chapters.summary: One-way and two-way separated bike lanes and side paths: street/sidewalk buffers, vertical separation, protected intersections, curb ramps, transit stops, and parking/loading.

chapters.title: Bicycle Boulevard Planning and Design
chapters.summary: Traffic calming, volume management, speed management, and major street crossings on bicycle boulevards (neighborhood greenways).

chapters.title: Design of Shared Lanes and Bike Lanes
chapters.summary: Shared lanes, paved shoulders, conventional bike lanes, and buffered bike lanes at midblock and intersection locations.

chapters.title: Traffic Signals and Pedestrian Hybrid Beacons
chapters.summary: Accommodating bicyclists at traffic signals and PHBs: bicycle signal faces, phasing, clearance intervals, timing, and detection.

chapters.title: Bicycle Facility Design at Interchanges, Alternative Intersections, and Roundabouts
chapters.summary: Design principles for freeway interchanges, DDIs, DLTs, quadrant intersections, and roundabouts.

chapters.title: Rural Area Bikeways and Roadways
chapters.summary: Rural highway and small-town connector bicycle design strategies, shoulders, and rumble strip accommodations.

chapters.title: Structures
chapters.summary: Overpasses, underpasses, bridges, railings, and grade-separated crossings for shared use paths and bikeways.

chapters.title: Wayfinding Systems for Bicyclists
chapters.summary: Bicycle wayfinding sign systems supplementing MUTCD 11th Edition guide sign provisions.

chapters.title: Maintenance and Operations
chapters.summary: Maintenance policy, design for maintainability, surface management, sweeping, and operations.

chapters.title: Bicycle Parking, Bike Share Siting, and End-of-Trip Facilities
chapters.summary: Short- and long-term bicycle parking, rack design, bike share station siting, and end-of-trip facilities.
